title: Alibi and Confession
author: Mirabel Okonkwo
blurb: Lena Almeida, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
